final: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT college_id, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college GROUP BY college_id), all_colleges AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT AVG(c.player_count) AS average_count, AVG(1.0 * c.player_count / a.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.player_count - a.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM college_counts AS c CROSS JOIN all_colleges AS a WHERE c.player_count > a.avg_count
